summary: Built journey-synthesis core: Cypress and Playwright spec readers (AST-parsed, replayable steps kept, custom commands/intercepts/fixture state recorded as named unhandled notes), a loopback-only bounded crawl fallback, and an emitter mapping to the real-app JourneyEvidence shape with a closed measured-pins vocabulary that refuses verdict words by construction. Added the witness-synthesize operator command with a PipelineRefusal, wired into OPERATOR_COMMANDS, PIPELINE_STAGES and the census. 18 new tests. Verified: lint, npm test (2580/2580, run before a whitespace-only revert), trust:verify --offline (c9941f8f), receipt:verify, census --verify-only, FREEZE-INTACT. real-app-run.ts carries only the JourneyEvidence type export.
